meta.name: hook-setup
meta.description: Inspect and install CCAM monitoring hooks for Claude Code and Codex. Use when onboarding a provider, repairing missing hooks, checking which provider is active, or validating that installation preserved unrelated user hooks.

howto.what_en: This skill inspects and installs CCAM monitoring hooks, ensuring session events from Claude Code or Codex reach CCAM; it replaces only CCAM-owned entries and preserves other hooks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when onboarding a new provider, repairing missing hooks, or checking the current provider.

say_en.note: Run ccam hooks status to see missing items

say_en.text: Verify events reach CCAM after install
say_en.note: Start a session and confirm events arrive
